records.text: I feel very confident that Andrew Kolvet was aboard the Santa Barbara-to-Scottsdale flight that took off shortly after Charlie Kirk was shot.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Andrew Kolvet was aboard this flight. I feel very confident stating that if he comes out and says he wasn't. ... I'll adjust, right? But looking at all the facts, let's think about it. The flight takes off five minutes after Charlie is shot, okay?

verification.notes: Owens presents an inference from message timing and flight timing, not a passenger record. Later reporting cites a flight manifest stating Kolvet and his wife flew directly from Santa Barbara to Provo and did not stop in Scottsdale, so public accounts conflict and the passenger claim is not established.

sources.relevance: Reports manifest-based counter-evidence to the claimed Santa Barbara-to-Scottsdale passenger route.

records.text: My very strong opinion is that the TPUSA core crew met at Scottsdale Airport and then traveled together to Provo aboard Charlie Kirk's plane.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So yeah, I am suggesting that they all met up at Scottsdale Airport. My very strong opinion is that is what transpired on that day based on the evidence that is sitting before us

records.text: My theory is that Andrew Kolvet departed Santa Barbara for Scottsdale at approximately 1:03.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This is what I believe happened. I'm putting this out as my theory: that Andrew departed from Santa Barbara, headed for Scottsdale, at approximately 1:03, according to his memory.

verification.notes: Owens explicitly labels this a theory. Later reporting cites a September 10 manifest with a different direct Santa Barbara-to-Provo departure at 2:30 p.m. Pacific and no Scottsdale stop. Because the manifest itself is not publicly inspectable, the conflict prevents a conclusive result.

sources.title: Factual errors: Jessica Reed Kraus challenges Candace Owens timeline
sources.relevance: Reports a competing manifest-derived departure time and direct route.

records.text: I believe Charlie Kirk's plane departed Scottsdale at 2:31 with the TPUSA group aboard and headed for Utah.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: 231, Charlie's plane. ... I believe with all of them on it departs from Scottsdale and heads for Utah.

verification.notes: Public flight trackers confirm that relevant aircraft exist but accessible historical records did not provide a passenger manifest establishing the TPUSA group aboard a 2:31 Scottsdale-to-Utah flight. Live searches returned only repetitions of the podcast theory.

records.text: Erika Kirk and Andrew Kolvet did not hug in Provo; Candace Owens concludes the tarmac hug occurred in Scottsdale.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Erika and Andrew did not hug in Provo, which only leaves us with Scottsdale.

verification.notes: The 3:30 pickup audio supports a timing problem for a late Provo reunion, but later reporting cites a manifest and account placing Kolvet and his wife on a direct Santa Barbara-to-Provo flight and the reunion in Provo. The competing accounts are not resolved by a publicly inspectable manifest.

sources.title: Factual errors: Jessica Reed Kraus challenges Candace Owens timeline
sources.relevance: Reports a competing account placing the flight and subsequent reunion in Provo rather than Scottsdale.

records.text: The New York Times reported that Charlie Kirk's chartered plane returned to Scottsdale to take Erika Kirk to Provo and that he was pronounced dead while she was airborne.
records.speaker: The New York Times

appearances.snippet: It says, 'Mr. Kirk's chartered plane traveled back to Scottsdale to ferry his wife to Provo.' ... He was pronounced dead as she was airborne.

verification.notes: The New York Times article and contemporaneous coverage report the charter-plane return to Scottsdale and state that Charlie Kirk was pronounced dead while Erika Kirk was airborne. The statement accurately represents what the article reported; this does not independently validate every underlying travel detail.
